description: RICOPOP is a neon ricochet arcade puzzle. Aim a volley, bounce balls off walls and shatter every crystal in as few shots as possible. Build chain reactions, charge the Pulse and chase three stars across 50 levels in 10 chapters. Unlock six ball styles and switch between 14 languages.
instructions: Drag with the mouse or your finger to aim then release to fire Balls return automatically Use wall bounces to hit crystals from different angles Press Escape or the pause button to pause Use the speed button to accelerate a volley

title: Try Again
description: Try Again is a tricky physics platformer. Roll your ball through 70 levels that fight back: floors that vanish, traps that wait for the perfect moment, and levels that behave differently on every attempt. Every death teaches you something. Remember where the traps hide, find the safe timing, and reach the portal. Every 10 levels a new zone and a new boss level wait for you, and new ball colors unlock as you go. Die, learn, and try again.
instructions: Keyboard Arrow keys or A D to roll Up W or Space to jump Esc or P to pause Touch hold the left button to roll tap the right button to jump

title: PushPlush
description: Meet the fluffiest puzzle challenge! Slide entire rows and columns to match three or more creatures of the same color. Create bombs, unlock trapped fluffies, and discover giant 2x2 characters. Complete 50 levels, solve picture puzzles, or relax in endless Zen mode. Enjoy colorful creatures, lively animations, and simple mouse or touch controls.
instructions: Drag a fluffy with your mouse or finger to slide its entire row or column Release to match 3 or more of the same color In Puzzle mode slide rows and columns to recreate the target picture

title: Dinos Rush
description: Dino Rush is a colorful and addictive platform adventure where every level brings a new challenge! Run, jump, and fight your way through exciting worlds filled with dangerous obstacles, tricky platforms, enemies, and hidden rewards. Collect coins, unlock new levels, and upgrade your dinosaur to become faster and stronger. Visit the in-game shop to purchase speed upgrades, jump improvements, and powerful boosters like Golden Magnet, Feather Wings, and Coin Fever. Enjoy unlimited levels with increasing difficulty, daily rewards, achievements, and exciting challenges. Test your skills, beat your best times, and see how far you can go!

title: Open Rings
description: Open Rings is a relaxing ring puzzle about freeing gems. Every level is a tangle of faceted rings, sliding bars and little locks. Turn a ring, pull a bar and slip each piece off the board without letting anything collide. Features: - 384 levels, from gentle warm-ups to tricky tangles. - Rings, sliding bars, locks that open when other pieces are gone, and bombs that blast everything around them. - Collect diamonds to earn gems, then spend them on boosters: Hammer, Hint and Firework. - A free daily gift: 5 of every booster, every day. - Plays in 12 languages, on phone and desktop.
instructions: Drag around a ring to turn it Double-tap a ring to put it back Hold still for 1 second to put every ring back Tap Hammer Hint or Firework in the bottom bar to use a booster Use the and - buttons to zoom
tags: 2D, Brain, Logic, Puzzle, Relaxation

title: Muscle Rush 3D
description: Muscle Run is a fast-paced runner where every choice makes you stronger—or weaker! Race through colorful tracks, choose the best multiplier gates, collect protein and avoid junk food. Train at gym stations, lift weights, fight rivals and dodge dangerous obstacles. At the finish line, swing your hammer to send the puck up a towering high striker and win rewards. Unlock outfits, customize your hero, upgrade your strength, collect diamonds and conquer 100 challenging levels across five worlds!
instructions: Mobile touch hold and drag to steer Tap to punch during fights and to swing the hammer Desktop Mouse drag or Left Right arrow keys or A D to steer Click or press Space Enter to punch and to swing the hammer
